proof_0433.moves: Structural induction on the red-black node, with a three-way case split on the comparison result, showing the insertion function preserves the Ordered invariant in each branch.

proof_0434.moves: The right factor of a concatenation is a sublist of the whole list (reflexivity plus the append-sublist lemma), and well-formedness of a basis is inherited along sublists.

proof_0435.moves: Exhibit an explicit colimit cocone: take the pushout of the already-existing span, package its two legs into a PushoutCocone, and use the epi-comp variant of the pushout universal property to see it is a colimit; conclude HasPushout by Nonempty of a ColimitCocone.

proof_0436.moves: Prove both implications of the iff: unfold semicontinuity as a neighborhood-filter condition and, in one direction, use that an open set containing the point is a neighborhood; the other direction is the definitional membership rewriting of the sublevel/superlevel set.

proof_0437.moves: Rewrite the 64-bit bitvector of the USize conversion using the known toBitVec-of-toUSize lemma, then push that rewrite under the width cast by congruence and close by reflexivity; the real content is width bookkeeping between numBits and 64 via setWidth.

proof_0438.moves: Introduce the hypothesis n+1 <= 0 and case on the inductive definition of Nat's order: neither constructor can produce a successor below zero, so the case analysis is vacuous and yields False.

proof_0439.moves: Case on the walk (it is not nil, so it ends in a cons/concat step) and read off the adjacency of the penultimate vertex with the endpoint from the final edge of the walk; the argument is an induction packaged into a generated helper.

proof_0440.moves: Unfold the ForIn instance for monadic iterators to the underlying IteratorLoop.forIn and transport the hypothesised equality of loop bodies through by congruence under binders; the proof is essentially pure equality/HEq transport, which here really is the content.

proof_0441.moves: Destructure the hash map into its raw representation plus the well-formedness proof, repackage as the size-positive subtype, and apply the corresponding internal Raw-level lemma; no new mathematics, it is a lift across the wrapper.

proof_0442.moves: Transport both sides to bitvectors via toBitVec, use that complement commutes with the representation map, and finish with the corresponding bitvector commutation of negation; the surrounding structure is a simp certificate.

proof_0443.moves: Purely definitional: unfold the short complex sc1 attached to the spectral object and read off its middle object X2, closing by reflexivity.

proof_0444.moves: Push the nonnegative-real distance through the coercion to the reals, so that nndist x y = 0 becomes dist x y = 0, and apply the metric-space separation axiom dist_eq_zero.

proof_0445.moves: Unfold the Int8 order relations to the corresponding order on the underlying integers via toInt, then apply the integer mixed-transitivity lemma.

proof_0446.moves: Unfold deleteVerts as the induced subgraph on the vertex set minus the deleted set, apply the adjacency characterisation of induce, and expand set-difference membership into a conjunction with a negation.

proof_0447.moves: Use the criterion for when two drops of a list agree, then normalise the index arithmetic: min is associative and min n (length) is already at most the length, so clamping twice is clamping once.

proof_0448.moves: Transport to bitvectors (complement commutes with toBitVec) and use that a bitvector of positive width is never equal to its own complement, discharging positivity of the platform word size.

proof_0449.moves: Unfold the extended norm as the coercion of the nonnegative norm into the extended nonnegative reals, then use that this coercion reflects and preserves the order (coe_le_coe).

proof_0450.moves: Destructure the hash map into its raw buckets plus well-formedness witness, repackage as the size-positive subtype, and delegate to the internal Raw-level lemma about getD under a false contains.

proof_0451.moves: Rewrite prev of a nonstart position as the normalised posLT form, then apply the characterisation of when a position is at most posLT, which turns the inequality into strict inequality.

proof_0452.moves: Contrapose the iff and use that a Finset fails to be nonempty exactly when it is empty, then invoke the characterisation that the support of a free abelian group element is empty exactly when the element is zero.

proof_0453.moves: Definitional unfolding: the trivial group object is the tensor unit with its canonical structure, so its unit morphism is the identity by construction; closed by reflexivity.

proof_0454.moves: A continuous affine map is differentiable everywhere; restrict that global differentiability to the given set using Differentiable.differentiableOn. One-step forwarding.

proof_0455.moves: Purely definitional: the strict betweenness relation on Fin is by construction the one coming from its circular order instance, so the iff holds by Iff.rfl.

proof_0456.moves: In a preorder viewed as a category, take the top element as the candidate terminal object: every object has exactly one morphism to it (le_top, plus homs being subsingletons), so the unique-morphism criterion for a terminal object applies.
